story.text: 콘서트에 다녀온 뒤로, 하늘의 휴대폰에는 그녀의 팬클럽 공식 앱까지 몰래 깔려 있었다. 본인은 그 사실을 죽어도 인정하지 않았지만.

story.en: After the concert, Haneul had secretly installed her official fan club app on his phone. Not that he would ever, under any circumstances, admit to it.

story.text: 매일같이 올라오는 팬클럽 게시글에는, 그녀를 향한 애정 어린 댓글이 수천 개씩 달려 있었다. 하늘은 그걸 읽다가 묘하게 기분이 가라앉는 걸 느꼈다.

story.en: Every day, the fan club posts filled up with thousands of comments overflowing with affection for her. Reading through them, Haneul felt his mood sink in some strange, unfamiliar way.

story.text: 손님이 물었다. '왜 그렇게 표정이 안 좋아요?' 하늘은 애써 아무렇지 않은 척했다. '…아니에요. 그냥, 좀 못마땅해서요.' '뭐가요?' '…됐어요, 신경 쓰지 마요.'

story.en: She asked, 'Why do you look so unhappy?' Haneul tried hard to seem unbothered. '...It's nothing. I'm just — a little displeased, that's all.' 'About what?' '...Forget it, don't worry about it.'

story.text: 그가 정작 못마땅한 건, 수만 명이 그녀에게 보내는 응원이었다. 다들 진심으로 그녀를 좋아한다는 게, 이상하게 그의 속을 긁었다.

story.en: What actually bothered him was the cheering — the sheer volume of support pouring in from tens of thousands of people. The fact that all of them genuinely adored her scraped at something inside him, in a way he couldn't quite name.

story.text: 손님이 장난스레 웃으며 말했다. '설마 그거, 질투예요?' 하늘의 얼굴이 순식간에 굳었다. '…말도 안 되는 소리 하지 마요. 제가 왜요.'
story.reading: son-nim-i jang-nan-seu-re us-eu-myeo mal-haess-da. 'seol-ma geu-geo, jil-tu-ye-yo?' ha-neul-ui eol-gul-i sun-sik-gan-e gud-eoss-da. '…mal-do an doe-neun so-ri ha-ji ma-yo. je-ga wae-yo.'
story.en: She teased, grinning. 'Don't tell me that's jealousy.' Haneul's expression froze instantly. '...Don't say something so ridiculous. Why would I be.'

story.en: Even as he denied it, he had no choice but to admit it to himself — this was the first time in his life that someone's popularity had ever bothered him this much.

story.text: 한참 침묵하던 하늘이 결국 작게 인정했다. '…맞아요, 질투. 됐죠? 이제 그만 물어봐요.' 그의 목소리 끝이, 평소답지 않게 조금 풀려 있었다.

story.en: After a long silence, Haneul finally admitted it, quietly. '...Fine, jealousy. Happy now? Stop asking.' His voice, at the very end, had softened in a way that wasn't like him at all.

words.example_en: I installed the official fan club app.
He truly felt how popular she was.

sentences.en: He secretly installed the fan club app.
Tens of thousands of cheers poured in.
For some reason, he wore a displeased expression.
